title: Best NZ Beaches for Families — Safest, Most Fun, by Region
meta_desc: Discover the best NZ beaches for families, with safe swimming, patrolled beaches and amenities from $10-$20 per day
intro: With over 15,000 km of coastline, New Zealand has plenty of amazing beaches to choose from, but which ones are best for families? Look for patrolled beaches with safe swimming areas and amenities like Bethells Beach in Auckland, which charges $10 for parking. Summer is the perfect time to explore these hidden gems with your kids. From the Far North to Invercargill, we've got you covered with the top NZ beaches for a fun and stress-free family holiday.

sections.heading: North Island Beaches
list: Bethells Beach, Auckland - $10 parking, patrolled beach, picnic areas and BBQ facilities
Pakiri Beach, Northland - 2.5 hour drive from Auckland, $5 parking, safe swimming and surf lessons from $50 per person
Oriental Bay, Wellington - free parking, patrolled beach, playground and water sports rentals from $20 per hour

sections.heading: South Island Beaches
sections.body: The South Island has some of the most beautiful and safest beaches in New Zealand, with many of them located in the Abel Tasman National Park. These beaches offer calm and clear waters, perfect for swimming and snorkeling. Some popular spots include Kaiteriteri Beach, which has a campground with sites starting from $20 per night, and Marahau Beach, which has a range of accommodation options, including holiday homes and lodges.

sections.heading: Safety First
sections.body: When choosing a beach for your family, safety should be the top priority. Look for patrolled beaches with lifeguards, and make sure to swim between the flags. It's also important to check the beach conditions before heading out, and to always supervise your children when they're in the water. Some popular patrolled beaches in New Zealand include Mount Maunganui Beach in the Bay of Plenty and Waikanae Beach in the Kapiti Coast, both of which have free parking and a range of amenities.
